title: Pakistan's UN Envoy Accuses India at UNGA of Exporting Terrorism Globally
detail: Pakistan's permanent representative to the United Nations escalated the bilateral diplomatic confrontation at the General Assembly, accusing India of exporting terrorism globally. The statement came in direct response to India's earlier rebuttal of Pakistani terrorism allegations at the same session, deepening the war of words between the two nuclear-armed neighbors on the international stage. The exchange marked the latest chapter in a sustained UNGA diplomatic offensive by both sides, with Pakistan invoking Kashmir and cross-border grievances while India pointed to Pakistan-based militant networks.

title: India Confirms Attendance at SCO Officials' Meeting in Pakistan
detail: India confirmed it will attend a Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) officials' meeting in Pakistan, marking a notable diplomatic engagement amid the ongoing bilateral freeze between the two nuclear-armed neighbors. The decision signals a limited willingness to participate in multilateral forums hosted by Pakistan despite the comprehensive bilateral freeze — no ambassadors, suspended trade, and the Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance. The SCO provides a multilateral framework under which India and Pakistan interact at a technical level without requiring direct bilateral normalization.
